title: AEOeye vs Profound: Free Instant Audit or Enterprise AEO Platform?
metaDescription: AEOeye vs Profound compared fairly: free instant multi-engine audit vs a sales-led enterprise AEO platform. Pricing, engines, setup, and who each is right
shortAnswer: AEOeye and Profound solve the same problem at opposite ends of the market. AEOeye gives you a free, instant audit across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini in seconds — no sales call, no contract, no setup. Profound is a sales-led enterprise platform with deep historical analytics, agent-traffic data, and broad engine coverage, but meaningful tracking starts around $399/mo, full coverage needs a custom contract, and dashboards take weeks to learn. Choose AEOeye to see where you stand today for free; choose Profound when you have a dedicated team and budget for ongoing enterprise-grade monitoring.
intro: If you're comparing AEOeye and Profound, you're really choosing between two very different ways to answer one question: *do AI engines recommend my brand, or a competitor's?* Both tools track how you show up in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Claude. The difference is everything around that core.\n\nAEOeye is built to give you an answer in seconds, for free, with no gatekeeping. Profound is built for marketing teams that have already decided AEO is a budget line and want an enterprise platform to own it long-term. Neither is \"better\" in the abstract — they're aimed at different buyers. Below is a fair, specific breakdown of where each wins, where Profound is genuinely stronger, and how to pick.

sections.heading: The core difference: instant and free vs. sales-led and deep
sections.body:
The single sharpest distinction is how you start.

With **AEOeye**, you type in your brand and run a free audit. Within seconds you see whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini recommend you for the questions your buyers actually ask, where you rank, and which competitors get named instead. No demo, no contract, no credit card. It's designed so a founder or a one-person marketing team can self-serve an answer before lunch.

With **Profound**, you book a demo. Every prospect is routed into a sales conversation, and full multi-engine coverage sits behind a custom Enterprise contract. The trade-off is depth: once you're set up, Profound gives you historical trend dashboards, citation-source analysis, agent/bot traffic analytics, and prompt-volume estimation that go well beyond a point-in-time check.

So the honest framing isn't "cheap vs. expensive." It's *"see your answer now, for free"* versus *"commit first, then get an enterprise-grade monitoring system."* Which one is right depends entirely on where you are in your AEO journey.

sections.heading: Where Profound is genuinely stronger
sections.body:
We won't pretend Profound is just an expensive version of AEOeye. For its target buyer, it does things AEOeye doesn't — and we'd rather you know that up front.

- **Historical depth and trend analytics.** Profound is built around longitudinal data: how your visibility moves week over week, which prompts drive it, and how citations shift over time. If you need board-ready dashboards and multi-month trend lines, that's its home turf.
- **Agent and crawler analytics.** Profound surfaces how AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.) crawl your site and which pages get pulled into answers — a genuinely useful enterprise signal.
- **Citation-source breakdowns.** It maps *which* third-party sources (Reddit, G2, publications) are feeding your mentions, helping a team prioritize off-site work.
- **Scale and seats.** Built for teams tracking many domains, large prompt sets, and multiple stakeholders, with onboarding tuned for larger accounts.

If you have a dedicated owner, an established marketing ops function, and a real AEO budget, Profound's ceiling is high. That's a fair thing to acknowledge.

sections.heading: Where AEOeye wins
sections.body:
AEOeye's advantages all come from removing friction and cost from the moment of truth.

- **Free to start, instantly.** You see real results across five engines without paying or talking to anyone. For most teams, the first job is simply *finding out if there's a problem* — AEOeye answers that for $0.
- **Blind multi-engine querying out of the box.** AEOeye asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini the questions real buyers type, then shows recommendations, ranking, and the competitors winning instead — no per-engine upsell to unlock the basics.
- **No learning curve.** There's nothing to configure and no dashboard to master. The output is built to be read by a non-expert and acted on the same day.
- **No sales call, no contract.** You're never locked into a commitment before you've seen value. That's the opposite of Profound's model, where many reviewers note the $99 Starter is effectively a ChatGPT-only demo and real coverage requires a bigger spend.

The honest caveat: AEOeye is newer and lighter on deep enterprise analytics and long-range historical dashboards. Its deeper multi-engine querying activates with usage rather than arriving as a 50-tab enterprise console on day one.

sections.heading: Pricing and the cost of finding out
sections.body:
This is where the two diverge most, so let's be precise rather than vague.

**Profound** is sales-led with no free self-serve trial. Public references point to a ~$99/mo Starter that is effectively ChatGPT-only, a ~$399/mo Growth tier that adds Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, a ~$499/mo Lite plan, and full multi-engine coverage on a custom Enterprise contract (real enterprise deals are commonly cited well into four figures per month). Reviewers consistently say the cost is hard for small teams and agencies to justify *before they can even see whether AI engines recommend them.*

**AEOeye** flips that. The audit is free and instant, so the cost of simply finding out where you stand is zero. You can run a check, share it with your team, and decide if AEO is worth investing in — all before spending a cent.

The practical implication: if you're still validating whether you have an AI-visibility problem, paying Profound's entry price to discover the answer is a steep way in. AEOeye lets you confirm the problem for free first, then choose how deep to go.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.body:
Here's a clean decision rule.

**Start with AEOeye if** you want to know *right now* whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini recommend you — for free. It's the obvious first move for founders, small and mid-size marketing teams, agencies running quick client audits, and anyone who isn't ready to commit to a contract or a multi-week onboarding. Even teams that eventually buy an enterprise platform should run a free AEOeye audit first to confirm there's a problem worth funding.

**Choose Profound if** AEO is already a funded initiative, you have a dedicated owner who can absorb a 1–3 week learning curve, and you need ongoing enterprise-grade historical dashboards, agent-traffic analytics, and large-scale prompt tracking. For mid-market and enterprise teams with established marketing ops, that depth can justify the price and the sales process.

Many teams use them in sequence rather than choosing once: AEOeye to get an instant, free read and build the internal case, then a heavier platform like Profound later if the scale and budget are there. The worst outcome is paying for an enterprise contract to answer a question you could have answered for free in seconds.

keyTakeaways: AEOeye gives a free, instant audit across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini — no sales call, no contract, no setup.
Profound is a sales-led enterprise platform: meaningful tracking starts around $399/mo and full multi-engine coverage needs a custom Enterprise contract.
Profound is genuinely stronger on historical trend dashboards, agent/crawler analytics, citation-source breakdowns, and large-scale team tracking.
Profound's dashboards are data-heavy and commonly take 1–3 weeks to learn, with reviewers calling the $99 Starter effectively a ChatGPT-only demo.
AEOeye's trade-off: it's newer and lighter on deep enterprise analytics and long-range historical dashboards; its deeper querying activates with usage.
Smart sequence: run AEOeye's free audit first to confirm the problem, then invest in an enterprise platform like Profound only if scale and budget warrant it.

faqs.q: Is AEOeye really free, or is it a limited trial like Profound's Starter?
faqs.a: AEOeye's audit is genuinely free to run — you can check how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini respond to your brand without paying or booking a call. That's different from Profound's ~$99/mo Starter, which reviewers describe as effectively ChatGPT-only. AEOeye's deeper, higher-volume multi-engine querying activates with usage, but the core instant audit across all five engines is available to start for free.

faqs.q: Does Profound cover more AI engines than AEOeye?
faqs.a: Both cover the major engines. AEOeye queries ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Claude, and Gemini in its audit. Profound advertises broad coverage including those plus Copilot and others — but on Profound that full coverage typically sits behind its Growth tier and custom Enterprise contract, whereas lower tiers are limited (the Starter is essentially ChatGPT-only). So the headline engine count is similar; the difference is what you can access without paying enterprise pricing.

faqs.q: When is Profound worth the price over AEOeye?
faqs.a: When AEO is already a funded initiative and you need ongoing depth: multi-month historical dashboards, agent and crawler traffic analytics, citation-source mapping, and large-scale prompt tracking across many domains and stakeholders. If you have a dedicated owner who can absorb a 1–3 week learning curve and a real budget, Profound's ceiling is high. For simply finding out where you stand today, AEOeye's free audit is the faster, cheaper move.

faqs.q: How long until I see results with each tool?
faqs.a: With AEOeye, seconds — you run the audit and immediately see whether you're recommended, where you rank, and which competitors win. With Profound, you first book a demo and go through a sales process, then onboard; reviewers report roughly 1–3 weeks before teams are fluent with the dashboards, though some report seeing initial engine outputs within a day or two of setup.

faqs.q: Can I use AEOeye and Profound together?
faqs.a: Yes, and many teams do it in sequence. Run AEOeye's free audit first to confirm whether you actually have an AI-visibility problem and to build the internal case. If the scale and budget justify it, layer on an enterprise platform like Profound for continuous historical monitoring and deeper analytics. Running the free audit first means you never pay an enterprise contract just to discover whether there's a problem worth solving.
